My experience today was very unpleasant. I arrived early for my appointment to have my dog's nails trimmed. My dog ​​is elderly and tires easily. I went to the register and was asked to wait, which I accepted without hesitation. After getting some water for my dog, I returned to wait near the grooming area, assuming my arrival had already been registered.

An employee, who was very kind, invited me in, but it seemed someone else had an appointment before me, which caused some confusion.

However, what really bothered me was the cashier's rude and disrespectful attitude. She didn't even take the time to clarify the situation.

I chose not to argue, but I believe every customer deserves to be treated with courtesy and respect.

Your opinion means a lot to us, thank you! We work to make every visit enjoyable for you and your companions.

We were given very thorough information about the services offered, as it was our first time at a Mondou store. A big thank you to her for guiding us; we will definitely be back to introduce our future companion!
Friendly service, no pressure, and the Mondou points system with recurring orders is very advantageous.

I would like to thank the staff at Mondou for their advice and support throughout my visit. The team was attentive and professional, and the store was very clean and welcoming. As a first-time dog owner, they were able to provide me with excellent information on food, grooming products, and much more! A special thank you to Meghan and Anouk for their help. I highly recommend this store if you need anything for your pet.

I feel so lucky to have Mondou Beaumont in my neighborhood. Celeste introduced  Nutmeg to a new treat . Plus it was on special because it is a feature of the month. She gave Nutmeg a treat and she loved it . So nice to try before buying . Nicholas always greats us with a warm hello and a treat for Nutmeg. Nico knows the food my dog likes and lets me know when it's on special. Great staff, well informed and great with dogs. I appreciate all the kindness and support you both give us.

I tried their delivery service. The amount of packaging is simply outrageous. For each bag of cat litter, which is absolutely not fragile, there's a box and plastic bags. Why put a bag with a carrying handle into a difficult-to-handle box? Poor delivery driver... Wake up, it's 2025...
The merchant's response to this review is clearly AI-generated. Otherwise, who would be "dim-witted" enough to ask me to explain the situation after I've precisely described it and supported it with photos? I'm therefore lowering my rating to one star.

I had booked a time slot to use the room to wash my dogs. Upon arrival (a 30-minute walk in the heat with my dogs), I was told that the policy had changed and that I now had to pay $10 per hour depending on my loyalty... I wish they had told me this earlier (when I made my reservation); it would have saved my dogs an hour's walk in the heat... (ps: I had no means of payment...)
Was told I could get a refund on an item that wasnt used, only to be told that they can only exchange it in store. Great, thanks for wasting my time.
